constraints.name: chk_inventory_transaction
constraints.definition: CHECK (((((transaction_type)::text = 'import'::text) AND (quantity_change > 0) AND (order_item_id IS NULL)) OR (((transaction_type)::text = 'sale'::text) AND (quantity_change < 0) AND (order_item_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((transaction_type)::text = 'return'::text) AND (quantity_change > 0) AND (order_item_id IS NOT NULL)) OR (((transaction_type)::text = 'adjustment'::text) AND (quantity_change <> 0) AND (order_item_id IS NULL))))

constraints.name: chk_order_items_values
constraints.definition: CHECK (((quantity > 0) AND (unit_price >= (0)::numeric) AND (discount_amount >= (0)::numeric) AND (discount_amount <= ((quantity)::numeric * unit_price)) AND (line_total = (((quantity)::numeric * unit_price) - discount_amount))))

constraints.name: chk_order_history_status
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((old_status IS NULL) OR ((old_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'shipped'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying])::text[]))) AND ((new_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'shipped'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[]))))

constraints.name: chk_order_history_transition
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((old_status IS NULL) AND ((new_status)::text = 'pending'::text)) OR (((old_status)::text = 'pending'::text) AND ((new_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['processing'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[]))) OR (((old_status)::text = 'processing'::text) AND ((new_status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['shipped'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[]))) OR (((old_status)::text = 'shipped'::text) AND ((new_status)::text = 'delivered'::text))))

constraints.name: chk_orders_status
constraints.definition: CHECK (((status)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['pending'::character varying, 'processing'::character varying, 'shipped'::character varying, 'delivered'::character varying, 'cancelled'::character varying])::text[])))

constraints.name: chk_orders_timeline
constraints.definition: CHECK (((created_at <= order_date) AND ((shipped_at IS NULL) OR (shipped_at >= order_date)) AND ((delivered_at IS NULL) OR ((shipped_at IS NOT NULL) AND (delivered_at >= shipped_at)))))

constraints.name: fk_orders_shipping_address_customer
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY (shipping_address_id, customer_id) REFERENCES customer_addresses(address_id, customer_id)
